preconditions.description: The number of vertices (n) and edges (m) are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v, _ in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects distinct vertices within the valid range.

preconditions.expression: all(c in {'B', 'R'} for _, _, c in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge's color is either 'B' (blue) or 'R' (red).
The number of edges provided matches the input value m.

postconditions.description: The output is either '-1' (no solution) or a non-negative integer k followed by k vertex indices.
If a solution exists, the output contains exactly k+1 integers (k moves and k vertices).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or all(1 <= int(v) <= n for v in stdout.strip().split()[1:])
postconditions.description: Each vertex in the output sequence is within the valid range.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (k := int(stdout.strip().split()[0])) == 0 or (all(1 <= int(v) <= n for v in stdout.strip().split()[1:k+1]) and len(set(stdout.strip().split()[1:k+1])) == k)
postconditions.description: If k > 0, the output sequence contains exactly k distinct vertices.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (k := int(stdout.strip().split()[0])) == 0 or (all(1 <= int(v) <= n for v in stdout.strip().split()[1:k+1]) and len(set(stdout.strip().split()[1:k+1])) == k and (lambda moves: all(edge_color(u, v, moves) == edge_color(u, v, moves) for u, v, _ in edges))(stdout.strip().split()[1:k+1]))
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, the sequence of moves makes all edge colors equal (either all 'B' or all 'R').
